title: Practice: Lead Shuffle Knee
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The owner's lead shuffle knee, added to the app's Technique Library as Muay Thai › Lead Shuffle Knee (cues, mistakes, next from there; the existing Lead Knee entry is the clinch knee, so the shuffle got its own). Thai: khao yao (เข่ายาว), the long knee: a straight knee thrown with a step from range. Footage: the owner's clip 25 (ring, 2026-11-03), raw-footage/practice/p25.mp4, one shot of 5.6 s with two reps: a shuffle into the knee at 0.9 s, a second at 4.3 s.

props.description: The long lead knee off a shuffle step
props.hookSub: Lead shuffle knee. Khao yao. 20 seconds.

cues.label: SHUFFLE
cues.say: Coach: "The rear foot slides up behind the lead. That's the step that closes the gap."

cues.label: HIPS
cues.say: Coach: "The hip goes through first. The knee is just what it carries."

cues.text: Spear with the point of the knee
cues.label: THE POINT
cues.say: Coach: "Toes pulled back, so the point of the knee leads. Not the flat of the kneecap."

watch.fix: Hips through, not just knee up
watch.label: HIPS
watch.say: Coach: "Lift the knee without the hip and it's a tap. Push the hips through and it folds them."

notes: 2026-11-03 cut from clip 25 at the owner's word. One shot of 5.6 s with two reps, so the beats share footage: key points 1 and 3 on the first rep (shuffle, then the knee's point), key point 2 and the WATCH FOR freeze on the second, the fix from the first. The drill runs the whole clip at 0.9× to fill its 6 s. In the second rep the shuffle switches the feet, so the right knee fires; the words still hold. No voice yet. Owner approves before anything posts; TikTok as Only me first.
2026-11-03 Thai name: khao yao (the long knee, thrown with a step from range) fits the shuffle knee better than khao trong, which is the plain straight knee; the rear knee takes khao trong.
2026-11-03 subtitle now "the long lead knee", matching the Thai name khao yao and the library entry.
